extra: State-machine tournament, generation 1 (Handoff 9.2). Eight hand-written machines spanning the families worth trying - two pure clocks (one a two-state control), a map-reactive pair with and without a commit timer, an objective window, a fight-reactive machine, an economy-reactive one, and a five-state machine - drawn per game alongside two fixed anchors: plain T2_search, the constant across generations, and T2_sieger, the strategy to beat.

Ten tiers over 800 seats is about 80 games each. Rank on the lower confidence bound (report 9d), keep the top 2, breed 8 for generation 2. Read every candidate's record against the anchors, not its overall win rate. Same rules, roster and P-0008 values as batch_0039; dragon_ap_each 1.

What would settle something: a machine whose lower bound clears T2_sieger's says switching beats sieging; every survivor sitting in sieger most of the game says the state machine is unnecessary and RQ-037 is confirmed from a second direction.
